description_html:
The Yocan Evolve Plus Wax Starter Kit is a portable concentrate vaporizer with quartz dual coils for clean, flavourful vapor. Features a built-in silicone wax jar and 1100mAh battery for extended sessions.

  • Product Type: Concentrate Vaporizer
  • Battery: 1100mAh
  • Voltage: 3.8V (at Full Charge)
  • Wattage: 25W (at Full Charge)
  • Coil Type: Quartz Dual Coil (Pre-Installed)
  • Coil Resistance: ~0.8Ω
  • Built-In Wax Jar: Removable Silicone
  • Charging: Micro-USB (Pass-Through)
  • Safety: Low Voltage, Short Circuit, Overtime (10s Cut-Off)
  • Connection: 510 Thread
  • Brand: Yocan

For use with wax concentrates only. Concentrate not included.

Available options: Silver, Apple Green, Azure Green.
